notable_absence.finding: Recurrence, not new: two error descriptions cite discrete Couchbase Server version numbers on this Capella (continuously-deployed, no-discrete-version) page - 'The server version must be at least 7.6.0' (code 6028, bucket storage-backend migration) and 'This operation is only supported for server version 7.6.0 and above' (code 11014, collection modification). Same recurring anomaly flagged in prior rounds; not treated as new here.

cross_component_finding: Error codes 8022-8024 (ErrCreateDataplaneUserRoleDoesNotExist, ErrDeleteDataplaneUserRoleInUse, ErrDataplaneUserRoleNotFoundOnCluster) reveal that the Management API's database-credential model directly reuses the existing privilege:capella-basic-access-read/write pair (named literally as 'data_reader / read' and 'data_writer / write') for Basic credentials, and the rbac-role:role placeholder for Advanced-credential database roles - confirming these error-catalog entries describe the exact same data-plane access model already captured from the SQL++ statement pages, rather than a third parallel vocabulary. Separately, error 1001 (Unauthorized) ties mgmt-api:api-key's IP-allowlist property (first seen in management-api-start.json) directly to a concrete HTTP error: 'Please make sure the client IP that is trying to access the resource using the API key is in the API key allowlist.'
